name: PM-KISAN
description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three installments to small and marginal farmers.
benefit: Rs 6,000/year (Rs 2,000 per installment, three times a year) directly to bank account.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a small or marginal farmer (cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares)
Must have a valid Aadhaar card
Must have a bank account linked to Aadhaar
application_steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)
Click 'Farmer Corner' → 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number and state
Fill in land and bank details
Submit; status can be checked online

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
benefit: Rs 5 lakh/year health cover for hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals, cashless.
eligibility_criteria: Family must be listed in SECC 2011 database or meet deprivation criteria
Annual family income below Rs 2.5 lakh (approx)
No existing government health insurance
application_steps: Visit pmjay.gov.in or nearest Ayushman Bharat Empanelled Hospital / CSC
Search eligibility by mobile or ration card number
If eligible, get Ayushman card printed at CSC
Use card for cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

name: PMAY-G
description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for rural homeless and kutcha house dwellers.
benefit: Rs 1.2 lakh (plains) or Rs 1.3 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for house construction.
eligibility_criteria: Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house
Listed in SECC 2011 Awaiting List or identified through Awaas+ survey
Annual family income below Rs 1.8 lakh
Must not have availed housing scheme before
application_steps: Contact Gram Panchayat or Block Development Officer
Get name verified in SECC / Awaas+ list
Submit application through Gram Panchayat
Funds released in installments directly to bank account after construction stages

name: MGNREGA
full_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members are willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefit: 100 days/year of employment at minimum wage (varies by state, approx Rs 200–350/day); paid to bank/post office.
eligibility_criteria: Adult member of a rural household
Willing to do unskilled manual work
Register at Gram Panchayat
application_steps: Apply for Job Card at Gram Panchayat with photograph and Aadhaar
Job Card issued within 15 days
Apply for work at Gram Panchayat when needed
Work must be provided within 15 days of application; otherwise unemployment allowance applies

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for girl children up to age 10, offering higher interest and tax benefits.
benefit: Current interest rate ~8.2% p.a. (revised quarterly); tax-free maturity amount; minimum deposit Rs 250/year.
eligibility_criteria: Girl child below 10 years of age
Account opened by natural or legal guardian
Maximum 2 accounts per family (one per girl child)
application_steps: Visit nearest post office or authorised bank
Fill SSY account opening form
Submit documents and initial deposit (min Rs 250)
Account matures 21 years from opening date

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Free LPG connection to women from BPL households to replace cooking with solid fuels.
benefit: Free LPG connection (deposit waived), subsidised cylinder refills.
eligibility_criteria: Woman adult member of BPL household
Age 18 or above
No existing LPG connection in the household
Listed in SECC database or from SC/ST/PM-AWAS-G beneficiary/forest dweller/PVTG/tea garden families
application_steps: Visit nearest LPG distributor (HP/Indane/Bharat Gas)
Fill Ujjwala application form
Submit documents
Connection provided free; first refill subsidy credited to bank

name: PM Scholarship (Central Armed Police)
full_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Railway Protection Force
description: Scholarship for wards of ex/serving personnel of CAPF and RPF pursuing professional degree courses.
benefit: Rs 3,000/month (boys) and Rs 3,500/month (girls) for up to 5 years.
eligibility_criteria: Ward of ex/serving CAPF or RPF personnel
Minimum 60% marks in Class XII
Enrolled in first year of professional degree (MBBS, BE, BEd, BBA, BCA, MBA, MCA etc.)
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill application under 'Ministry of Home Affairs'
Upload documents
Institute verification and approval

name: Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/OBC)
full_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST and OBC students
description: Financial assistance to SC, ST and OBC students pursuing post-matriculation courses.
benefit: Maintenance allowance (Rs 380–1,200/month) + course fees reimbursement depending on category and course.
eligibility_criteria: Belongs to SC, ST or OBC category
Enrolled in post-matric course (Class XI onwards)
Annual family income below Rs 2.5 lakh (SC/ST) or Rs 1 lakh (OBC)
application_steps: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during notification window
Select correct scholarship under state/central ministry
Upload documents; get institution verification
Funds disbursed directly to bank account

name: PM Vaya Vandana Yojana
description: Pension scheme for senior citizens offering guaranteed 7.4% p.a. return for 10 years through LIC.
benefit: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000–9,250/month for 10 years depending on investment (max Rs 15 lakh).
eligibility_criteria: Age 60 years or above
Indian resident
Investment between Rs 1.5 lakh and Rs 15 lakh
application_steps: Visit nearest LIC branch or apply on licindia.in
Fill PMVVY application form
Submit investment amount and documents
Pension credited monthly/quarterly/half-yearly/yearly as chosen

name: IGNDPS
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities who are below the poverty line.
benefit: Rs 300/month (central share); states may top up. Disbursed through bank/post office.
eligibility_criteria: Age 18–79 years
Severe disability (80% or more) or multiple disabilities
Below Poverty Line (BPL)
Not receiving any other pension from central/state government
application_steps: Apply at Gram Panchayat / Block Office / District Social Welfare Office
Submit disability certificate and BPL proof
Verification by district authority
Pension credited monthly to bank/post office account

name: IGNOAPS
full_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens.
benefit: Rs 200/month (age 60–79); Rs 500/month (age 80+). States typically add an equal or higher amount.
eligibility_criteria: Age 60 or above
Below Poverty Line
Not receiving any other pension
application_steps: Apply at Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office
Submit form with age proof and BPL certificate
District verification and approval
Pension transferred monthly

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers in case of crop failure due to natural calamities, pests or disease.
benefit: Claim payout based on crop loss assessment; premium as low as 1.5–2% for kharif/rabi, 5% for horticulture.
eligibility_criteria: Farmer cultivating notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers eligible
Enrolment before cut-off date for each season
application_steps: Apply through nearest bank (for loanee farmers, automatic enrolment)
Non-loanee: apply via CSC or PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in)
Pay premium amount
Claims assessed by state government after crop loss notification

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Provides farmers with timely credit for agricultural needs at concessional interest rates.
benefit: Credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% interest p.a. (with interest subvention); revolving credit limit.
eligibility_criteria: Farmer, sharecropper, oral lessee or tenant farmer
Allied activity farmers (fisheries, animal husbandry) also eligible
Must have agricultural land or lease agreement
application_steps: Apply at nearest bank branch (SBI, cooperative bank, RRB etc.)
Fill KCC application form
Submit land and identity documents
Credit limit sanctioned based on land area and crop; card issued

name: PM Mudra Yojana
description: Collateral-free micro-loans to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefit: Shishu: up to Rs 50,000 | Kishor: Rs 50,001–5 lakh | Tarun: Rs 5–10 lakh; no processing fee for Shishu.
eligibility_criteria: Non-farm micro/small enterprise or individual entrepreneur
Age 18 or above
No collateral required for Shishu category
Business plan required for Kishor/Tarun
application_steps: Apply at any bank, MFI or NBFC, or online at udyamimitra.in
Fill Mudra loan application
Submit documents and business details
Loan disbursed after bank appraisal

name: NFBS
description: One-time lump sum assistance to BPL households on death of the primary breadwinner.
benefit: Rs 20,000 one-time payment to bereaved BPL household.
eligibility_criteria: Death of primary breadwinner aged 18–59
Household below poverty line
Claim within 1 year of death
application_steps: Apply at District Social Welfare Office or Block Office within 1 year
Submit death certificate and BPL proof
District verification
Amount transferred to claimant's bank account

name: SVAMITVA
full_name: Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas
description: Provides property rights to rural household owners by mapping land parcels using drones.
benefit: Legal ownership document (Property Card / Rights Record) for residential land in villages.
eligibility_criteria: Resident of a village covered under SVAMITVA survey
Occupying residential land (abadi area)
application_steps: State revenue department conducts drone survey
Provisional record shared for objections
Property card distributed by Gram Panchayat or state portal
Card can be used as collateral for bank loans

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers; government co-contributes for eligible subscribers.
benefit: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000–5,000/month at age 60. Government contributes 50% (up to Rs 1,000/year) for 5 years for non-tax-payers who joined by March 2016.
eligibility_criteria: Age 18–40 years
Indian citizen
Has a savings bank account
Not an income tax payer (for government co-contribution)
application_steps: Apply at any bank or post office
Fill APY subscriber registration form
Choose pension amount (Rs 1,000/2,000/3,000/4,000/5,000/month)
Monthly contribution auto-debited from savings account

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, accident insurance, and overdraft facility.
benefit: Zero-balance account; RuPay card with Rs 2 lakh accident insurance; Rs 10,000 overdraft for active accounts.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen above 10 years
No existing bank account (or can open under PMJDY for benefits)
Basic KYC documents
documents: Aadhaar card (or any officially valid document for KYC)
application_steps: Visit nearest bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra)
Fill account opening form
Submit KYC documents
RuPay card issued; account usable immediately

name: PMGSY
description: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations. Benefit is community-level infrastructure.
benefit: All-weather road access to village; not a direct cash benefit.
eligibility_criteria: Habitation without all-weather road connectivity
Population >= 500 (plains), >= 250 (hilly/tribal/desert)
application_steps: Gram Panchayat or district submits proposal through PMGSY portal
State-level approval and central sanction
Construction by state PWD or contracted agency

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises.
benefit: Loan Rs 10 lakh–1 crore at concessional rate; composite loan (term + working capital).
eligibility_criteria: SC/ST borrower, or woman borrower
Age 18 or above
Greenfield enterprise (first-time in manufacturing/services/trading)
Must not be in default with any bank or financial institution
application_steps: Apply at any scheduled commercial bank branch or on standupmitra.in
Submit business plan and documents
Bank appraisal; loan sanctioned within 3 weeks
Loan disbursed; repayment 7 years
